npcs.name: Nest ferch Rhys
npcs.idle: Have you heard them? At night? Don't listen if you do.

npcs.name: Gwion the Harper
npcs.idle: Every song in this valley ends in the lake. I've tried to write one that doesn't.

npcs.name: Brother Teilo
npcs.idle: Every brother in my house is dead and still walking. I am the only one who stayed dead-tired instead.

quests.title: The Hounds of Annwn
quests.offer:
My husband Iolo heard the hounds of Annwn three nights ago. The white hounds with red ears. Whoever hears them dies within the year - everybody knows that.

Iolo isn't one to wait for it. He took his spear and went to hunt them, to break the doom. Gwion the [harper] knows the old stories. Will you [go after Iolo]?

topics.harper: Gwion. He sits by the smithy, playing to anyone who'll stand still.

quests.summary: Iolo heard the hounds of Annwn - a death omen - and went to hunt them rather than wait to die.

steps.goal: Ask Gwion the harper about the hounds
steps.say: The Cwn Annwn hunt from the old stones south of here, on the slopes. Their master is a huntsman of the Otherworld. The story goes, if a living man blows the huntsman's horn, the hunt passes him by - but the doom must fall on someone. They always find someone. Iolo will go to the [stones].

steps.goal: Hunt the hounds of Annwn on the slopes
steps.text: They don't bleed. They fade, like breath on cold glass. Further south, a horn calls.

steps.goal: Search the old stones in the south
steps.text: Iolo's spear, the shaft bitten through. A trail of blood to the west - and the hunt's horn calling again, very close.
The huntsman lowers his horn and looks at you a long while. Then he and his hounds are gone, and only the horn lies on the grass.

stages.name: Gwyn's Huntsman
stages.announce: A tall grey figure rides out of nothing on a horse of mist, the white hounds at its heels. It lifts a horn.

steps.say:
You came for me? Nest sent you. Course she did.

I heard it, you know. In the howling. My own name. They've marked me. I'm marked. Unless the [horn]...

steps.goal: Decide what to do with the horn
steps.say:
If I blow it, the hunt passes me by - and the doom falls on whoever's near. On you, maybe. I won't do that.

If YOU [blow it], it falls on you. Gods, don't. Or we [break it], and I take what's coming. A year. A year is something.

options.say:
No - you - ...

Listen. They're going. Far off. They're running the other way. They know your name now, friend. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry, and so grateful I can't stand up.
Yes. Yes. A year with Nest. That's more than most men get. Come on, help me up.

steps.say:
He's home, and he says the doom is gone - and he won't tell me where it went.

I can guess. Thank you. I don't know what else to say. Take this. Be careful at night.

A year. He told me. He broke the horn and he chose a year with me, and he's smiling like a boy about it.

I'll make it the best year of his life. Here. For bringing him home to have it.

blown.text: Take this. Be careful at night.

quests.title: The Last Psalm
quests.offer:
I'm the last brother of the abbey in the north - the last living one. Thirty years ago our abbot made a pact with the ghosts of an old legion: they would guard our house from raiders. They did. They guarded it from everything.

This winter my brothers died one by one, and rose again, and went back to their prayers. I ran. I am not proud of it. Will you [go to the abbey]? The abbot's psalter holds the pact. Perhaps it holds a way out.
quests.summary: Brother Teilo's abbey made a pact with the ghosts of a Roman legion, and now his dead brothers walk.

steps.goal: Climb the road to the abbey in the north
steps.text: The abbey bell is ringing for vespers. Hooded monks walk the cloister in pairs. None of them cast a shadow.

steps.goal: Free the dead brothers of the abbey
steps.text: Each one says 'thank you' as it falls.

clue.name: a chained psalter on a lectern

steps.text: The pact is written in the margin of the psalm for the dead: 'Guard this house until the last brother leaves it.' And Teilo left.

steps.goal: Speak with the ghost of Abbot Elfodd
steps.say:
You have the psalter. Good. I made the pact. I meant it for our protection. The legion took it to the letter, as soldiers do - the last brother left, so the house is theirs, and so are we.

Their veteran, Decimus, holds the pact. Break him, and I can [read the last psalm].

steps.goal: Defeat Decimus, keeper of the pact
steps.text: The old soldier salutes you as he fades. 'Relieved. At last.'

stages.name: Evocatus Decimus
stages.announce: An old soldier in a red cloak plants himself in the cloister. 'This house is under guard. Stand down.'

steps.say:
Now I can read it - the last psalm, and every brother here goes to his rest, myself among them. The abbey will stand empty, and the raiders will come, and the valley will have no one to shelter it.

Or we [keep watch], the dead brothers and I, without the legion - and the valley keeps its shelter. Teilo would have to live with that. Tell me: do I [read the psalm]?

options.say: Then listen. ... It's been a long time since I could hear myself sing.
Then we watch. Tell Teilo we are not angry. Tell him to visit, if he can bear it.

steps.say:
I heard them. All the way down here. Singing - all of them, the old psalm. And then the bell stopped.

I'll go back in the spring and sweep the chapel. Somebody should.

They're keeping watch. Still. Without the legion.

I'll visit. I'll bring bread they can't eat and news they can't use. I suppose that's what brothers are for.
